content.short: Paj is an offramp letting users convert crypto to fiat directly from their own wallet.
content.description: Paj converts crypto to fiat directly from a user's own wallet, bridging stablecoins to African bank accounts. Its public API is built around a single primitive: an integration registers each user's bank account with a bank code and account number, then initiates payouts against it with the fee already applied. Most integrations are small as a result, needing only account registration and payout calls. API keys are self-serve.
content.meta: Cash out to fiat straight from a self-custody wallet, skipping the exchange account.
